risk_note: RV2 by path (apps/api/src/modules/content/**). CT-07f (split from CT-07e by D10-1986; deps CT-07e #270): contracts/home-schema.json product_pool data source gains optional tags (each normalized tag 1-16 code points, no control character, at most 10); on save the console page config normalizes the tags (NFKC, trim, inner whitespace to one, drop empty, dedupe keeping order, case kept) and refuses a list that ends up empty with 20001 (data.fields sections.N.data_source.tags), writing nothing; the home section read filters pool items by tag intersection inside the existing app_id / pool_id scoped statement (tags && $1::text[]), the fallback pool (feed.fallback_pool_id) is never filtered; delivered and preview pages drop tags from product_pool sources without touching stored or cached versions. The content module keeps its own copy of the normalization steps (content -> catalog index import would form a cycle), accepted by D10-2034 with its unit test taking the catalog normalization table row by row; FU-POOL-TAGS-NORMALIZE-SINGLE follows right after this task.
